slots.practicalActivity: Open Report Builder and SQL Server Data Tools (SSDT) side by side; connect each to a sample SQL Server instance (e.g., AdventureWorks) and compare the project/report-opening workflow in both tools; sketch the report-server request/render pipeline (client -> Report Server -> data source -> rendered report).
slots.deliverable: A short written comparison (5-6 bullets) of when to use Report Builder vs. SSDT, plus a labeled diagram of the SSRS report-server architecture.

slots.practicalActivity: In SSDT, create a new Report Server Project, add a shared data source pointing to AdventureWorks, create one blank .rdl report, configure the project's deployment properties (TargetServerURL, TargetReportFolder), and deploy the project to the Report Server.
slots.deliverable: A deployed, empty report visible in Report Server's web portal under the configured folder, with the deployment settings (server URL, folder path) documented.

slots.practicalActivity: Create a new report with a shared data source and a dataset built from a multi-table query (e.g., Sales.SalesOrderHeader joined to Sales.Customer in AdventureWorks). Explore the design surface: drag dataset fields into the Report Data pane, place several fields as standalone text boxes on the body, and preview.
slots.deliverable: A working .rdl report with one data source, one dataset (at least 5 fields from a joined query), and a preview showing live field values on the design surface.

slots.practicalActivity: Build a Table report listing order details (OrderID, OrderDate, CustomerName, TotalDue) with a header row and alternating-row shading. Then build a separate Matrix report pivoting the same data by Year (columns) and Product Category (rows), showing SUM(TotalDue) in the cells.
slots.deliverable: Two rendered reports in preview: a formatted table report and a cross-tab matrix report with correct row/column totals.

slots.practicalActivity: Add a group to the Slot-4 table report (group by Customer, with a group header showing Customer Name and a group subtotal), sort detail rows by OrderDate descending within each group, then apply layout best practices: consistent margins, aligned column widths, and a page header/footer with report title and page number.
slots.deliverable: An updated table report with customer grouping, subtotals per group, sorted detail rows, and a clean, print-ready layout with header/footer.

slots.practicalActivity: Combine the chapter's techniques into one polished report: a grouped, sorted Table or List showing order detail grouped by Sales Territory with subtotals, plus a separate Matrix tablix in the same report comparing yearly sales by product category, both laid out on a single page with consistent formatting, headers, and footers.
slots.deliverable: One finished multi-tablix report (table/list + matrix) deployed to the Report Server, demonstrating datasets, grouping/sorting, and layout best practices working together.

slots.practicalActivity: Add a report parameter @Category to the chapter-review report with a dataset-driven list of values, set a default value (e.g., the top-selling category), then convert the parameter to allow multiple selected values and update the dataset query/filter to handle the multi-value IN() condition.
slots.deliverable: A report that runs with a default category pre-selected, and that correctly filters results when the user selects multiple categories from the parameter dropdown.

slots.practicalActivity: Add a second parameter @Subcategory whose available values depend on the selected @Category (a cascading parameter driven by a filtered dataset query), and verify the dependent dataset re-queries correctly when the parent parameter changes.
slots.deliverable: A working cascading-parameter report where changing Category updates the Subcategory list, and the main dataset is correctly re-filtered by both parameters.

slots.practicalActivity: Open the Expression Editor on several report items and write expressions for: a concatenated full-name text box (=First & " " & Last), a running total using RunningValue(), an IIF-based status label, and a page-numbering field (=Globals!PageNumber & " of " & Globals!TotalPages).
slots.deliverable: A report where at least 4 text boxes use custom expressions (concatenation, running total, conditional IIF, page numbering), all verified correct in preview.

slots.practicalActivity: Apply conditional formatting to the TotalDue column (red bold text when the value exceeds a threshold, e.g., $5,000) using expression-based Color/FontWeight properties, and apply consistent text box formatting (fonts, borders, padding, alignment) across every textbox in the report.
slots.deliverable: A report where high-value rows are visually highlighted via conditional expressions, and all textboxes share consistent, professional formatting.

slots.practicalActivity: Apply number/date/currency formatting across the report: format TotalDue as currency ($#,##0.00), OrderDate as a long date, and a discount field as a percentage with one decimal, using both the Properties pane format codes and custom Format expressions.
slots.deliverable: A report where every numeric, date, and currency field displays with correct, locale-appropriate formatting.

slots.practicalActivity: Build one consolidated "Sales Summary" report that applies the chapter's full toolkit together: custom expressions for calculated fields, conditional formatting highlighting outliers, and proper number/date/currency formatting throughout, then deploy it to the Report Server.
slots.deliverable: A single deployed report demonstrating expressions, conditional formatting, and formatting codes working together correctly on real data.

slots.practicalActivity: Add a Chart (clustered column or line chart) showing monthly sales totals by year, configuring series, category groups, and the legend; then add a radial Gauge showing current-month sales against a target, configuring scale ranges and the pointer.
slots.deliverable: A report page with a working column/line chart showing correct series grouping and a gauge visual showing an accurate scale, pointer position, and target range.

slots.practicalActivity: Add KPI Indicators (up/down arrows) to a summary table showing whether each category's sales increased or decreased vs. the prior period, and add Sparklines inside the table's detail rows showing each product's sales trend over the last 12 months.
slots.deliverable: A table report where each row shows a trend-indicator icon and an inline sparkline mini-chart, both reflecting correct underlying data.

slots.practicalActivity: Build a single-page "Sales Dashboard" report combining a chart, a gauge, KPI indicators, and sparklines on one canvas, laid out in a grid with consistent sizing and a title for each visual element.
slots.deliverable: A deployed one-page dashboard report containing all four chapter visual types (chart, gauge, indicator, sparkline) rendering correctly together.

slots.practicalActivity: Convert the grouped sales table into a Drilldown report (toggle visibility on detail rows nested under category/subcategory headers), then build a separate detail report and configure a Drillthrough action on a summary report's Category cell that passes the clicked value as a parameter to open the detail report.
slots.deliverable: A summary report where clicking the +/- toggle expands/collapses detail rows (drilldown), and clicking a category cell opens a correctly filtered drillthrough detail report.

slots.practicalActivity: Embed a Subreport (e.g., a customer's order history) inside the main sales report, passing a parameter from the parent to the subreport; then add Bookmarks on group headers and build a Document Map so users can jump directly to a given category/subcategory section.
slots.deliverable: A report with a working embedded subreport filtered by a passed parameter, plus a navigable document map/bookmark tree in the report viewer.

slots.practicalActivity: On the deployed Sales Summary report, create a Standard Subscription (scheduled email delivery to a single recipient with a chosen render format), then create a Data-Driven Subscription driven by a subscriber table (e.g., a per-region email list) so each recipient receives the report pre-filtered to their own region parameter.
slots.deliverable: A configured standard subscription visible in Report Server's subscription list, and a working data-driven subscription whose delivery query produces one correctly parameterized delivery per subscriber row.

slots.practicalActivity: Configure a subscription to deliver to a Windows file share (as a PDF) in addition to email, and configure its schedule using a shared schedule (e.g., weekly Monday 6am) versus a report-specific schedule, comparing the two scheduling approaches.
slots.deliverable: A subscription delivering a rendered PDF to a file share path on a defined recurring schedule, with shared vs. report-specific scheduling documented.

slots.practicalActivity: Design a complete delivery plan for the Sales Summary report suite: one standard subscription for executives (email, monthly), one data-driven subscription for regional managers (file share, weekly, parameterized by region), each with an appropriate schedule, and document the configuration choices and why each delivery method/schedule fits its audience.
slots.deliverable: A short delivery plan document plus both subscriptions actually configured and tested on the Report Server, with evidence (screenshot or subscription log) that each fired correctly.

slots.practicalActivity: In Report Server's web portal, create a folder structure for the report suite (e.g., /SalesReports/Summary, /SalesReports/Detail), configure item-level security by assigning the Browser role to a test user/group on one folder and the Content Manager role on another, and verify access differs between roles.
slots.deliverable: A documented folder structure with role assignments, verified by confirming a test "Browser" account can view but not edit, while a "Content Manager" account can both.

slots.practicalActivity: Enable caching on the Sales Summary report (a cache refresh plan on a schedule) and create a report snapshot history, then review the report's dataset query for performance issues (e.g., SELECT *, missing WHERE filters) and apply at least one optimization (push a parameter-based filter into the query, or add a covering index note).
slots.deliverable: A report configured with an active cache refresh plan and snapshot history, plus a documented before/after performance note on the dataset query optimization applied.

lessons.title: Capstone: Building a Real Paginated Report Suite

slots.practicalActivity: Define the capstone scope: a 3-report "Sales Operations" suite (an executive summary report, a detailed drillthrough report, and a regional subscription-delivered report) using real AdventureWorks data; then start building report 1 (the executive summary), creating its data source, dataset, grouping, and at least one chart.
slots.deliverable: A written one-page capstone scope/plan, plus report 1 of the suite (executive summary) built and rendering correctly with real data.

slots.practicalActivity: Continue the capstone: build report 2 (the detailed drillthrough report) with parameters driven from report 1's drillthrough action, including grouping, expressions, and conditional formatting carried over from earlier chapters.
slots.deliverable: Report 2 of the suite built, linked via drillthrough from report 1, and verified to pass and apply the correct parameter values.

slots.practicalActivity: Finish the capstone: build report 3 (the regional report with charts/gauges), configure security/folder placement for the whole suite on the Report Server, and set up a data-driven subscription delivering report 3 to each region's manager on a weekly schedule.
slots.deliverable: All 3 reports deployed to a single Report Server folder with correct security roles, and a tested data-driven subscription delivering report 3 per region.

slots.practicalActivity: Review the finished 3-report suite end-to-end (navigate from executive summary -> drillthrough -> regional report), fix any remaining layout/expression issues, write a short portfolio writeup describing the business problem solved and the SSRS techniques used (datasets, parameters, expressions, charts, drillthrough, subscriptions), and capture screenshots of each report.
slots.deliverable: A polished, bug-free 3-report SSRS suite plus a portfolio writeup (with screenshots) ready to showcase to employers.

monthlyMilestoneContribution: After this course, a student can design, parameterize, format, and visually enrich real paginated reports in SSRS, then deploy, secure, and automatically distribute them via caching, snapshots, and subscriptions on a production Report Server.
